judgment.notes: The complete P signature in type-Check.lean quantifies n,m:ℕ, u:Space n × Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) → Value m and q:Value m, followed by precisely H001–H006. H001 retains both positive dimensions. All scalars and derivatives are over ℝ; no additional abstract-field, instance or regularity binder is hidden in P. H003/H004 use the explicit sum of coordinate squares, equivalent in both directions to Euclidean norm one by nonnegativity, rather than the Pi supremum norm. H005 expands to ∀x t, 0<t → ∃a:ℝ, A−L=a•ubar, without a chosen scalar function or regularity assumption. H006 expands to ∀s t, 0<s → s<t → ∃compact C, ∀x r, x∉C → r∈Icc s t → ubar(x,r)=q: q is fixed, C can depend on the closed time slab, and no global compact set is imposed. All original hypotheses, including the unused q-unit hypothesis, remain in P. There are no external E roots. Tracing implementation helpers gives exactly the source direct boundaries after removal of freely available library inputs: R001/T001–T003 uses H001,H002; R002/T004–T005 uses H006,N001; R003/T006–T007 uses N001,N002; R004/T008–T009 uses H004,H005,N001; R005/T010 uses N001,N002; R006/T011–T012 uses N001–N005. Each T-input is an earlier planned output, not a new external H. No background note is promoted to a premise. The domains are nonempty and the hypotheses are consistent, for example with a fixed unit q and constant u=q.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
